name: @playliquid/replay
description: PlayLiquid GameOS replay platform primitive (PL-014, lock 15 / R8). Immutable, content-addressed replay records (game/world snapshot ref + command stream ref + capture range + provenance); a ReplaySource port reusable by players, QA, integrity and Lab; a deterministic re-execution engine that replays a recorded command stream against a Simulation Runtime session through the canonical command admission gate; and the probabilistic competitive-integrity evidence seam (R11): a verifier port comparing recorded vs re-executed event streams and emitting a typed verdict + confidence. Derivation appends artifacts and never rewrites source records (E10). Pure types, pure functions and in-memory fakes: no IO, no storage, no service implementation.
